game_concept: A logic puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Owl Roost, a night-time owl roost: the wood elf archer must handle bog toads while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Reverse Countdown: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches.
theme: Mystic Forest – Owl Roost: a night-time owl roost
core_gameplay_loop: In Owl Roost, repeat each round: Count backward with range(10, 0, -1) to time perfect launches. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the launch_timing value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Reach the spirit shrine using at most 10 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 10.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 10 before the spirit shrine is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Reverse Countdown
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Reverse Countdown' (Week 5 slot 8), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Owl Roost'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how launch_timing changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against bog toads in Owl Roost.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The spirit shrine reached with actions_used <= 10.
